summary.text: Graft wood is Divine Bean Palace's immortal killer move. It lets Divine Bean Palace take the attacks a protected target receives.

claims.text: Chen Yi stretches out his hand. Divine Bean Palace shakes, and two rays of profound light land on Old Ghost Bai Jun and Eagle Concubine, then enter their bodies. They inspect themselves and find nothing peculiar. When they are injured, profound light shines on their bodies and the damage is shifted away. Chen Yi’s voice sounds in their heads and names the method as Divine Bean Palace’s immortal killer move graft wood. Fang Di Chang sees them stay safe and sound no matter which killer moves hit them. Not only attacks, even time path and space path supplementary killer moves cannot affect them. He orders a healing killer move used on them. The healing has no effect. Chen Yi can tell Fang Di Chang is probing graft wood. Fang Di Chang orders Fang clan to ignore the two and target Divine Bean Palace instead. Flowery wind warriors self-detonate, and killer moves land on the palace. Divine Bean Palace shakes. Its core stays untouched. Only a large number of mortal Gu are destroyed.
Chen Yi can influence Divine Bean Palace to use three methods: green armor vegetable garden, graft wood, and myriad life spring lightning, and Fang clan has countered all three.

Fang clan’s rank seven Gu Immortals hit Chen Yi, then Fang Gong’s punch breaks Chen Yi’s defensive method. Chen Yi had used graft wood on himself as well. Cracks appear on the palace walls, spread to the roof and tall pillars, and several large pillars shatter into piles of Gu worm corpses.

Lu Wei Yin attacks Divine Emperor City and cannot fully eliminate the divine bean soldiers. The reason is Divine Emperor City’s other move, Graft Wood. The move lets the divine bean soldiers connect together and share the damage they suffer. The bulk of the damage goes to Divine Emperor City, while the soldiers bear the rest.
